tagline: Win the combat, pull a free stunt, then fish it back out of the discard

featuredCards.title: Porkpie Hat
featuredCards.caption: Either a card and an action, or the exact stunt you want back in hand. It sets up the turn before it starts.

featuredCards.title: death-defying stunts
featuredCards.caption: The stunts are six singletons — this shuffles two of them back in so the engine never actually runs out.

featuredCards.title:
Stunt - 
Falling House
featuredCards.caption: Played off the special ability it hits everyone next to him for three, for free, after a combat he already won.

featuredCards.title: "Tragedy is a close-up; comedy, a long shot."
featuredCards.caption: Cashes the last stunt in the discard pile as raw damage. The bigger the stunt, the bigger the bill.
